newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank shares fall to year low.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank shares fall to year low.

text.p: Shares in Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd slipped to the lowest price for the financial year on Wednesday morning.
The share price of the Japanese city bank lost seven yen to stand at 156 yen at 0108 GMT. It briefly fell to 155 yen, its lowest level for the current fiscal year which ends in March, 1997.
Brokers cited renewed speculation over the financial health of the banking sector after recent rounds of short-covering.
"Bank, especially Hokkaido Takushoku and Nippon Credit Bank Ltd have come back under heavy fire again today," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
"The weakness in banking sector shares is dampening trade across the board," he added.
